Diagnostic report: redis-prod (run-20260823T110000-abcd1234)
============================================================

Summary
Redis is at its configured memory ceiling. Eviction began before latency rose and the log shows write refusals in the same window, so memory pressure is the cause rather than a consequence.

1. [supported by the evidence, 85%] Redis reached maxmemory; eviction could not free space fast enough.
2. [refuted by the evidence, 5%] A single slow command blocked the event loop.

Gaps in the evidence: 1

Recommended next steps
  1. [low] Confirm the eviction policy with CONFIG GET maxmemory-policy.
  2. [medium] Raise maxmemory only if the host has headroom.
